specification: WWCP POI 3: the amounts of EV Taler (libs/WWCP_POI/concepts/EVTaler.md, open point 3), a concept of WWCP_POI, no part of SPECIFICATION.md; the session of example A16 in test-vectors/runs/csharp-76d3653
description: What a reader of an EV Taler session recalculates. A vector names a "currency" and a charging "tariff" with the elements that price it, as JSON text (the text of its numbers matters), and its check: "rates" the gross rates of the simple profile - "rates", decimals as texts without trailing zeros, the price of a kWh ("energyPerKWh") billed by "energyStepWh", of an hour ("timePerHour") billed by "timeStepSeconds", the flat fee ("flatFee"), each where the tariff has it - or, "notPriced", why the tariff has none ("reason"); "step" what a step covering "covers" costs, rounded up to the minor unit of the currency ("price", with the digits of the minor unit), or, "notPriced", that the tariff does not price it ("reason"); "session" the price of a session of "energy" kWh in "durationMs" milliseconds, the flat fee, the energy and the time each billed in its step size, rounded to the nearest minor unit, half away from zero ("price"). The numbers are calculated exactly, with fractions of integers.
